This '''individual''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Pacithhip/Legends|Pacithhip]] who served as a member of the [[Black Hole Gang/Legends|Black Hole Pirates]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="BHP 6" /> Like the rest of the [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], the Pacithhip lived aboard the ''[[Random Mallet]]'', trapped within the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] by the [[Gravity/Legends|gravitational]] pull of a [[Black hole/Legends|black hole]].<ref name="BHP 7" /> The Pacithhip pirate wore [[robotic stilts]] to help him fit into a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]]-dominated [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].<ref name="BHP 6" /> He was well-versed in [[Starship/Legends|starship]] technology, able to tell the make of a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] and whether it had been customized if given time to examine it.<ref name="BHP 7" />
